question: What rules and numbers govern bleed-out and revive in the soldier man-down graphs?

sourceFacts.method: Compiled expression graphs were listed with expression-graphs/exgraph.py (format from L4016, names from L4017 and L4019) and read section by section by a delegated reader; each constant cited here was then checked at its raw offset in the resource file. Full reading: expression-graphs/findings/soldier-state.md.

control.description: Every cited constant is a raw-offset check against the resource body. Function meanings marked inferred in the findings file are not relied on for the checked values.

points: `SimEx_IsInManDown`: `IsBledout` is set when `HealthValue` < -90. Drain = rate x frame time. Rate table 1.6667, 2.2222, 3.3333, 1.1111, selected by `ManDownExperienceType`; a fast case uses 200. Divided by a request-revive slowdown tunable (separate values for multiplayer, battle royale, Gauntlet and single player) and by `HemostaticSmoke_BleedoutMulti`.

`SimEx_DragRevive_Team`: total time from `ReviveTotalTime`, the Support and battle royale variants and `ActiveReviveTimeReduction`, floored at 0.1. Remaining time counts down by frame time x modifier; the modifier is `DraggingReviveTimeMovingModifier` when the reviver's speed is at least `Deathflow_MovingReviveSpeedThreashold` and the revive is past its first 0.75 s and before its last 0.7 s, otherwise 1.

Revive completion applies `AffectorRevive_HealthRestored` (entry chosen by a per-class health rank tunable), `AffectorRevive_Regen` (parameter `PostRevive_RegenerationDuration`), conditionally `Affector_Gadget_CeramicArmor` (parameter 0.1, entry 2), and removes the man-down damage modifier.
Redeploy and self-kill flags are set in `SimEx_DamageReceived` (L4019). No spawn-protection or friend/foe rule was found in these graphs.

inference: If the downed pool starts at 0 and ends at -90, the four rates give about 81, 54, 40.5 and 27 seconds; the starting value is not read, so these durations are not established.
Which rate belongs to which man-down type is not decodable (switch case order unread).
unresolved: Squad-wipe handling passes through undecoded operations; only its structure is readable.
Listings lose alignment after some switch instructions, so some class selectors are unmapped.
Tunable values (revive times, modifiers) are named here but stored elsewhere.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Man-down and revive graphs read: a downed soldier bleeds out when HealthValue falls below -90 at one of four rates (1.111, 1.667, 2.222, 3.333 per second, or 200 in a fast case), and drag-revive time counts down with a moving modifier outside 0.75 s start and 0.7 s end windows
leads.summary: The man-down and revive graphs were read. A downed soldier is flagged bled out when HealthValue drops below -90; the drain rate is one of 1.111, 1.667, 2.222 or 3.333 per second chosen by man-down type, or 200 in a fast case, and is slowed by request-revive and hemostatic smoke tunables. Revive time comes from class and mode tunables with a 0.1 floor; the moving-revive modifier applies only outside the first 0.75 s and last 0.7 s. Completion applies health, regeneration and armour effects. 11 raw-offset checks matched.
